results.title: Dear Fatima
results.overview: A decade after the murder of her daughter Fátima at the age of 12, the victim of a brutal femicide, Lorena Gutiérrez takes a stand outside the National Palace to demand a meeting with Mexico’s first woman President.

results.title: All That’s Due
results.overview: 16 years after “Love of the Children“, the drama tells the story of Mira and her patchwork family. She has recently taken over the management of a supermarket. Her relationship with her husband Tarik and her two daughters gives her support. But a single weak moment in which Mira fails to tell the truth leads to other half-truths and lies until everything blows up in her face.

results.title: PH-1
results.overview: A promising politician is held hostage in his luxurious penthouse by a remote captor, forced to watch his life destroyed by social and conventional media as he tries to figure out who is behind it and why.

results.title: Hijacked
results.overview: A rideshare abduction sparks a deadly race as a father hunts to rescue his influencer daughter and their loved ones from a deranged driver.

results.title: Heatwave
results.overview: Angsty 17 year-old Marcelo must buy a fan for his grandma on the hottest day of the year but events quickly spiral out of control...

results.title: Remembrance
results.overview: A young woman, Grace, escapes captivity and wakes with no memory. Detectives attempt to piece together who she is and why she was targeted, but get far more than they bargained for while searching for answers as Grace starts to relive memories without knowing if they're real or imagined.

results.title: The Great Money Robbery
results.overview: Pushed by betrayal, bullying, and desperation, Wu Xiaobao is drawn into an armed bank robbery and slowly descends into a dark, irreversible path.

results.title: Oscillation
results.overview: In the house where a father and daughter live together, a heavy silence lingers, and an unbridgeable distance remains. The father toils at an inexplicable task, while the daughter goes through her days in a quiet routine. But soon, a strange change overtakes his body.

results.title: Blessings
results.overview: Ray and Tyler go on a fishing trip. Ray has a proposal; hilarity ensues.

results.title: Is It Cake? Valentines
results.overview: Cupid's arrow has struck the Is It Cake kitchen for the first-ever Valentines special! Three baking couples of master cake artists compete. Together, they tackle ALL NEW games, craft swoonworthy cakes, and attempt to fool the judges and each other! AND for the first time in Is It Cake history, there are games just for the viewer! With hearts pounding and money on the line, these couples are in for the sweetest date night of their lives!

results.title: Cyclone
results.overview: A transgender woman from mainland China travels to Hong Kong with a single, urgent goal: to undergo gender-affirming surgery. Moving through the city in a state of emotional suspension, she navigates temporary lodging, medical bureaucracy, and fleeting encounters with strangers who alternately offer intimacy, indifference, or quiet solidarity. As the date of the operation approaches, her journey becomes less about the procedure itself than about the weight of expectation, fear, and self-recognition.

results.title: There Will Be Light
results.overview: There Will Be Light is the first documentary in Taiwan to focus on a site recognized for its significance to transitional justice. Centering on Gikong Presbyterian Church, the first citizen-nominated site officially designated by the Ministry of Culture, the film revisits one of the darkest chapters of Taiwan’s authoritarian era—the 1980 Lin Family Massacre.

results.title: Khoriya
results.overview: Two Nepali half-brothers run a poultry farm on the outskirts of a city. The older brother wants to expand the farm, while the younger dreams of becoming a soldier and settling down with his girlfriend. When their livelihood is threatened by an outbreak of the avian flu, the older brother turns to the illegal trade of steroids by targeting military recruits, and drags his younger brother into the business. His girlfriend, who works in the beauty industry, decides to leave for Dubai in search of bigger opportunities.

results.title: Folk Mysteries Record
results.overview: In order to avenge his unborn daughter, Song Lan uses psychedelic drugs to pretend to be a ghost and thereby cover up the secrets of the existence of Jin's treasures. Detective Han Sanqi stripped the cocoon of the bizarre case that occurred in the Song family's mansion, which not only arrested the real culprit, but also thwarted the conspiracy of various forces coveting Jin's treasures. Eventually guarding the treasure at the expense of the sacrifice, thus sublimating humanity.

results.title: The Lotto Winner
results.overview: It follows an ordinary family whose lives are abruptly transformed by extraordinary luck—unraveling how money can both bind people together and quietly pull them apart.

results.title: BILLION DOLLAR BABIES
results.original_title: Milliarden Dollar Babies: Große Gewinne mit kleinen Aalen
results.overview: Hidden beneath the surface of the world’s waterways flows one of the most secretive and lucrative trades on Earth — the trafficking of baby eels. BILLION DOLLAR BABIES is a gripping narrative that exposes the billion-dollar global network built on one of nature’s most mysterious creatures — and the blurred moral lines between survival, greed, and conservation.  What begins as an investigation into an obscure fishing niche unfolds into a shocking expose of globalised crime and environmental neglect. Despite being listed as a critically endangered species, the European eel has become one of the most valuable commodities on the black market — worth more than cocaine by weight and the most trafficked animal in the world.

results.title: Whitmer Thomas: Terminal Crew of Dudes
results.original_title: Whitmer Thomas: Terminal Crew of Dudes
results.overview: Comedian, musician, and actor Whitmer Thomas digs into his small-town Alabama upbringing and his ongoing quest to be cool.

results.title: Hunted
results.overview: In the midst of the 2017 Chechen gay purge, a young gay man is arrested, tortured, and forced into an impossible choice: betray the people he loves or die for them. He must summon the courage to defy a system determined to erase him.
